title: A channel that runs no skill script ends the skills' preamble with a note that script execution is not available, before the manifest
notes: Python: channels/_ai_context.py _add_skills: SKILLS_PREAMBLE, then SKILLS_NO_SCRIPTS_NOTE when the channel has no script executor or its policy denies run_skill_script, then a blank line and the manifest (channels/_skill_constants.py).

system_prompt.$contains:
You have access to Agent Skills — specialized knowledge packages. Use the activate_skill tool to load a skill's full instructions before using it. Available skills are listed below. Note: Script execution is not available in this environment.
